controller.feedback: common plant truth in SIL; calibrated motion capture in physical trials
controller.feedforward_reference: PDF commanded-thrust/desired-axis expression; snap derivative holds feedback correction locally fixed; yaw reference is fixed
controller.frame: world ENU, body FLU, scalar-first Hamilton quaternion body-to-world

course.timing_status: 40-second commissioning reference; measured outcomes are reported separately, not a fastest-speed claim

qualification.gains_tuning: equal step-response criterion and documented tuning budget
qualification.native_control_algorithm_changes_allowed: bounded angular-rate and angular-acceleration feed-forward additions only; feedback unchanged
qualification.performance_margins_status: must agree before campaign; PDF numbers are examples
requires: native disarm and grounded stopped motors

betaflight.hover_throttle_status: mean commanded PWM fraction over 30–35 s of closed-loop native Betaflight hover at 2 m in the shared plant
